8 اعتكموا They equalized the أَعْدَال [i. e. the burdens called أَعْكَام, pl. of عِكْمٌ], in order to their taking them up and carrying them, (K, TA,) and binding them upon the camel, or camels, that was, or were, to bear them: Az says, I have heard the Arabs say thus to their servants on the day of departure. (TA.) ―
-b2- And اعتكم الشَّىْءُ The thing was, or became, heaped up, one part upon another: (K:) or mixed. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
